entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to make a return. My order number is VF881-0945.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up that order... I see it's for the AeroFlow Helmet. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue?
Yes, it's the helmet. Honestly, the color just isn't what I expected from the website pictures. It's a much brighter red than I thought.
I see. So it's more of a preference with the color, not a technical fault with the item itself?
That's right. The box is unopened, I haven't even tried it on. I just feel that for safety, I want a color I'm completely comfortable with when I'm on the road. This one is a bit too flashy for me.

I completely understand. Let me just check the purchase date... Okay, I see the item was delivered 36 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can definitely process that return for you.

I've just initiated the return authorization. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.

That's very helpful, thank you. Now, since I am going through the hassle of packing this up and taking it to the post office, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next VeloFit order? Maybe for 15% off?

I understand your request, but since we are covering the full cost of the return shipping and providing a full refund, I'm not able to add an additional discount code. The prepaid label is the accommodation we provide for the inconvenience.
Alright, that's fair enough. I had to ask. I appreciate you processing the return so quickly.
You're very welcome. The email with the label has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, David.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
